name: Connecticut

regions.name: Southern uplands, coast and River Valley (MLRA 144A, 145)

context: CT 340: Cover crops here are chosen by MLRA and plant hardiness zone; the standard lists wind and water erosion among its purposes.
CT 380: Windbreak protected zone is 10H on the leeward side and 2H on the windward side; plant perpendicular to the erosive wind.
cover_rules: CT 340: Best erosion results come when canopy plus surface residue cover is 90 percent or greater during erosive wind or rain.
CT 340: In a colder zone within an MLRA, plant earlier in the seeding date range.
residue: CT 329: Maintain a minimum of 60 percent residue cover (flat) on the soil surface throughout any period the standard names.
CT 329: Use current wind erosion prediction technology to set residue amount and timing; do not burn residue.
disturbed: CT 342: Critical area planting can stabilize areas with high rates of soil erosion by wind or water, including sand dunes.

cover.name: Cereal rye
cover.rate: 112 lb/ac (2 bushels) up to September 15; 140 lb/ac (2.5 bushels) later
cover.note: CT 340: Use clear-tag seed; dates depend on MLRA and elevation.

cover.name: Oats
cover.note: CT 340: Winterkills in CT; protects through winter only if planted by September 10.

cover.name: Winter wheat
cover.note: CT 340: Winter period protected if seeded by October 1.

cover.name: Hairy vetch
cover.note: CT 340: Seed by September 1 for winter protection.

cover.name: Annual ryegrass
cover.note: CT 340: Winter protection if seeded by September 15.

cover.name: Buckwheat
cover.note: CT 340: Fall protection if seeded by July 15.

coverPlant.text: CT 340: In MLRA 144A and 145, early fall seeding runs Aug 14-Sept 14; fall Aug 14-Oct 1.
CT 340: In MLRA 144A and 145, spring seeding runs Apr 7-May 21.

seedWin.text: CT 340: Cereal rye in MLRA 144A and 145 coastal areas: up to September 30 at 112 lb/ac, October 1 to October 10 at 140 lb/ac.
CT 340: Cereal rye on MLRA 144A and 144B uplands above 1,000 feet: up to September 15 at 112 lb/ac, September 16 to September 25 at 140 lb/ac.
